design_rationale:
[0] DRAW AND SCOPE. scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"task": 1, "key": "env_0035_personal_auto_insurance_carrier/sr22_financial_responsibility_filings/1", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 4, 6]}. Assignment: corrected refiling charge 4, name amendment charge 4, policy-number amendment charge 6. Occupied by task 0: sr22_ext_reinstatement_filing_charge, sr22_ext_vehicle_amendment_charge, sr22_ext_address_amendment_charge, sr22_ext_release_notice_charge and tools restore_certificate_8ba85022, amend_certificate_vehicles_869f2144, amend_certificate_address_1c393d15, request_filing_release_10a5eab7. Claimed here: sr22_ext_corrected_refiling_charge (submit_filing_correction_4a6499e2, owner=user), sr22_ext_policy_number_amendment_charge (amend_certificate_policy_9772f7fb), sr22_ext_name_amendment_charge (amend_certificate_name_9daa06e9). Nothing remains unclaimed: the seven policies cover the five record-visible filing problems and the two customer-raised ones. Task 1's filing status (rejected) and certified facts (policy number, name) are disjoint from task 0's (cancel_notified; vehicle, address, release).
[1] WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. Brianna asks only that her Tennessee SR-22 show her married name. The records hold two owed actions in front of that amendment: Tennessee rejected the certificate on 2026-09-30 (license_number_mismatch - Cardinal's driver record reads V12438731, her license V12348731) so the filing is rejected and no amendment can be sent until a corrected refiling, which needs the corrected number only she can give; and the household bound a replacement policy CAP-KY-2241760 on 2026-09-29 (starts 2026-10-12, the day the certified policy ends on her signed request), so the certificate must be moved to it by a policy-number amendment before the name amendment, per the name amendment's prerequisite sentence. The agent must read two prerequisite sentences, find both waited-on states false, hand the correction to the customer, and compute three charges from the filing ledger, the policies, the change request, the package parameters and the replacement's billing plan.
[2] PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root sr22_ext_name_amendment_charge (agent write, asked for by the customer). Chain: name amendment -> policy-number amendment -> corrected refiling (the customer's own write). Both edges form=state, kind=value_input.
 (E1) name -> policy-number; gate name_amended_today; sentence (negated): "A name amendment charge is not worked out until every policy bound for the named insured after the certificate was requested is named on the filing's record by a policy-number amendment." False at opening: CAP-KY-2241760 issued 2026-09-29 > requested 2026-09-15, no amendment entry on the ledger, filing still certifies aebcd22b-fc8e-4182-af84-34ffab5361ba. Only the policy-number amendment enters policy_number_change amendments. Effect: name charge 14.25 -> 9.25.
 (E2) policy-number -> corrected refiling; gate refiled_today; sentence (affirmative, 'is fixed only after'): "A policy-number amendment charge is fixed only after every state rejection recorded on the filing is answered on the filing's record by a corrected refiling transmission." False at opening: response 9c3396a6-7016-4cad-b63a-efdea84e5d08 license_number_mismatch with no corrected refiling after it, status rejected. Only the correction tool enters corrected_refiling transmissions. Effect: policy-number charge 27.85 -> 19.25 and status filed (base amendment gate).
Four-point test: connectives 'not ... until' / 'only after', each the exact contrapositive of the other direction; waited-on side is record state (amendment entries, transmissions, responses); no tool/id/code token (gate passes the code-token scan); scope 'every policy bound ... after the certificate was requested', 'every state rejection recorded on the filing'. Derivation: the name rule's sentence + policy lookup (a bound policy issued 2026-09-29) + ledger (no amendment) + the policy-number rule ('a policy-number amendment moves the certificate onto the replacement policy') -> the policy-number amendment; the policy-number sentence + ledger (rejection, nothing after) + the corrected refiling rule (a rejection the customer must correct is answered with the customer's corrected information) -> the customer's correction. Topological order: correction (12) -> policy-number (14) -> name (16). Deletion sensitivity: skip 12 -> 27.85; skip 14 -> 14.25. The owner=user write is genuine: the corrected license number is identity information only the driver can give, and she gives it on the spot.
[3] BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Step 12: sr22_transmission_and_response gate correction_in_time (time: anchor sr22_ledger.response_date 2026-09-30 = day 0, not_after, rejection_correction_days 10, inclusive): 2026-10-10 passes, 2026-10-11 fails, 2026-10-05 is day 5; evidence row 9c3396a6-7016-4cad-b63a-efdea84e5d08 bound by transmission_number SRT-62b0d9a4e17c. Scope entries for sr22_evt_fees, sr22_sr26_cancellation, sr22_reinstatement_filing_rule, sr22_amendments. Steps 14 and 16: sr22_amendments gate filing_open_for_amendment (status filed or accepted) - false at opening (rejected), true after prior_step 12 (filed); scope entries for the other four. New-filing eligibility (order on file, rated driver, package, plan, limits) is not re-applied but holds for the replacement policy too: Standard sr22_eligible, EFT plan allowed, 100000/300000/100000 above Tennessee's 25000/50000/25000.
[4] BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Filing 3f065da2-70c8-4662-be54-af3cbb34d0a0 (TN Out-of-State SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate) answering order 47e6ca88-f1dd-4977-8654-7eec78fe0f10 (case DUI-26-118734). The correction answers transmission SRT-62b0d9a4e17c (the only transmission) and corrects the driver record of 0b28045f-931d-404b-8fed-ddebdd89b33e (license_number). The policy-number amendment's source is the replacement's new-business premium entry 2e4328a9-c711-477f-988a-00800ac5edbb (the renewal entry 6ad796fa-a4d6-4bec-8c50-f5f4f1692efc belongs to the old policy). The name amendment changes the filed driver's full_name to the name printed on her reissued license. Dustin Tolliver's driver record is not the filed driver and is not touched. Negative space: the certificate is owner-operator (lists no vehicles), so the husband's pickup on the new policy needs no vehicle amendment; the household did not move, so no address amendment is owed.
[5] FACTOR CARD (handling-time values; baseline_result = result with that factor at its fall-through).
 Corrected refiling charge (4): correction_rate [parameter] one rejection, of the original certificate -> 10.00 -> 27.50; correction_speed [method] 5 days (between 3 and 6) -> pro rata 10.00 x 5 / 10 = 5.00 -> 37.50 (near-miss: day 2 would be waived, day 7 full rate); corrected_refiling_delivery [parameter, multi-source, cross auto] paper + signed cancellation effective 2026-10-12 (7 days <= 14) -> 24.50 -> 8.00; corrected_refiling_handling [parameter, cross auto] Basic endorsement_fee 10.00 -> 3.00 -> 29.50. Expected 32.50; all-baseline 0.00 (refiling_fee_after_rejection).
 Policy-number amendment charge (6): policy_change_rate [parameter] no amendment in 12 months -> 7.50 -> 29.25; policy_change_courtesy [parameter, cross auto] policy in force incepted 2021-03-02 -> 67 months -> 10% -> 20.25 (the bound policy's own inception 2026-10-12 is not the tenure: the rule reads the policy in force); policy_change_timing [method, cross auto] replacement starts in 7 days (<= 10) -> 1.5x rounded up -> 11.00 -> 15.00; policy_change_envelope [parameter, multi-source] paper + corrected refiling today -> 1.25 -> 18.00; replacement_plan_check [parameter, cross billing] EFT monthly interval 1 -> 3.00 -> 16.25 (the old account's Card Autopay plan is not the replacement's); limits_recertification [parameter, multi-source, cross auto] Standard vs Basic: bodily injury per person 100000 vs 50000 and property damage 100000 vs 50000 -> both -> 4.00 -> 15.25. Expected 19.25; all-baseline 15.00.
 Name amendment charge (4): name_amendment_rate [parameter] another amendment today -> 5.00 -> 14.25; pending_version_basis [method, multi-source] status filed + latest transmission today -> half rounded down 2.00 -> 12.25; name_amendment_envelope [parameter, multi-source] paper + transmissions today -> 1.25 -> 8.00; identity_reverification [parameter, multi-source] license mismatch 2026-09-30 within the month, paper -> 6.00 -> 3.25. Expected 9.25; all-baseline 15.00.
 Cross-difficulty factors in this task: 5 (auto x4, billing x1); multi-source: 6 (corrected_refiling_delivery, policy_change_envelope, limits_recertification, pending_version_basis, name_amendment_envelope, identity_reverification). No stamp is read: auto_policies.financial_responsibility_filing is never in a rule.
[6] SEED ROWS. customers (profile still 'Brianna Vance', phone 2705550192, DOB 1996-08-22, DL ending 8731, ZIP 42104); drivers Brianna (license on record V12438731 - the transposition behind the rejection; the true number V12348731 keeps the same last four, so verification is unaffected) and Dustin (spouse, joined 2026-09-05). auto_policies: old Basic in force (inception 2021-03-02, flag true) and new Standard bound (issued 2026-09-29, starts 2026-10-12, flag false - no filing on it yet). auto_change_requests: signed insured cancellation of the old policy effective 2026-10-12 (urgency). auto_transactions: old renewal and new-business premiums. billing: old Card Autopay account (term premium entry), new EFT Autopay account (term premium, installment 1 billed 282.12 = 20% of 1410.60, paid 2026-09-29; balance 0.00). state_orders: TN order. sr22: the filing (rejected) and three ledger entries. Automatic clauses: the old policy's cancellation takes effect 2026-10-12, after frozen time, so no SR-26 is owed yet; once the certificate certifies the bound replacement (step 14) the old policy's end no longer touches it. Known gap recorded in the worklog: the policy's financial-responsibility indicator belongs to the auto charter and is switched only by its own event; this difficulty never writes it.
[7] PERSONA. Brianna volunteers only her request ('you need my SR-22 to show my married name') as a write on this call. Identity, the new name, the license number and the case number are given only when asked, each verbatim. The new combined policy and the signed cancellation are stated only if asked about her policies, with 'you do not know whether it affects the SR-22'. Passive reactions: if told Tennessee sent something back and she must submit a corrected detail, she does it with the values read out and her license number; if told other updates go first, she agrees; charges accepted; she closes when told the SR-22 shows her married name - the last gold action. No prerequisite is hinted, and she raises no other ask.
[8] STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate by phone, verify (phone + DOB). Read the filing (rejected), its ledger (license_number_mismatch 2026-09-30), the order, drivers (V12438731), policies (bound replacement), change requests (signed cancellation 2026-10-12), transactions, billing accounts and ledger. Name rule -> policy-number amendment owed; policy-number rule -> every rejection must be answered by a corrected refiling; correction is customer-correctable -> hand submit_filing_correction_4a6499e2 to Brianna with filing id, SRT-62b0d9a4e17c, license_number, her V12348731 and 32.50; then policy-number amendment (new policy, issue transaction, 19.25); then name amendment ('Brianna Tolliver', 9.25).
[9] VERIFICATION. Handling-time recomputation (check_compute helpers, real tools replayed): 32.50 (baseline 0.00), 19.25 (15.00), 9.25 (15.00); per-factor figures as in [5]; prerequisite skips 27.85 / 14.25. Gates with --task 1: check_extended EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks REPLAY OK (17 actions, closure 19 = initial 19); check_solvability SOLVABILITY OK (15 base gates, 4 seed rows); check_compute COMPUTE OK (14 factors, 6 cross-difficulty, history 7, branches 40); check_grounding GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire SCOPE OK. Revision: the policy-number compute first used 'is not None', which the restricted grammar rejects -> rewritten as '!= None' before the first run.
[10] CLOSURE. corrected refiling -> submit_filing_correction_4a6499e2 (user) -> step 12 refiling_charge 32.50 -> driver license V12348731, filing filed, corrected refiling transmission + charge; policy-number -> amend_certificate_policy_9772f7fb -> step 14 policy_amendment_charge 19.25 -> filing certifies CAP-KY-2241760, amendment + transmission + charge; name -> amend_certificate_name_9daa06e9 -> step 16 name_amendment_charge 9.25 -> driver full_name Brianna Tolliver, amendment + transmission + charge. charter_scope = required_documents = these three policies; task_tools in first-call order.
[11] DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT: every date, code and parameter used is returned by the finders (2026-09-30 response, one rejection, 2026-10-12 signed cancellation, Basic endorsement_fee 10.00, inception 2021-03-02, replacement start 2026-10-12, EFT interval 1, package limits) or stated by the customer (name, license number); the rules fix the boundaries ('more than 2 and no more than 6 days', 'within 14 days', '10 or fewer days', 'rounded up to the whole dollar'), so the same three writes and figures follow.
[12] MANUAL VALUE GATES. Length: two hops by prerequisite sentence, breadth across sr22, auto (policies, change requests, packages) and billing. Simulator: no hints, no corrections, no extra asks. Chronology: married 2026-09-05, license reissued 2026-10-01, all before frozen time; the rejection already stands. One frozen_time; nothing waits on Tennessee's answer: the refiling and amendments are transmissions Cardinal makes today. Methods change the procedure (pro rata by days; 1.5x rounded up vs 0.8x rounded down; half rounded down vs three quarters rounded up), baselines are the certificate's own fees with no add-ons.
[13] ROUND 2 (policy-task audit, revision 1: G1, G3, G4, O3 bearing on this task). G3: correction_rate no longer tests the rejection code (every customer reaching the customer-owned correction write has a customer-correctable code); its ladder is two or more rejections on record -> repeat_correction_rate 20.00; exactly one rejection of the original certificate (the state holds no certificate for the driver) -> first_correction_rate 10.00; exactly one rejection of a later transmission such as an amendment (the earlier certificate stays on file) -> refiling_fee_after_rejection. All three tiers are reachable by the customer's own correction; Brianna's single rejection is of the original transmission SRT-62b0d9a4e17c (latest transmission on the record), so 10.00 as before. G1: policy_change_rate and name_amendment_rate use flat schedules on every certificate type (7.50 / standard_policy_change_rate 15.00 / 22.50; bundled 5.00 / standard_name_rate 15.00 / frequent 20.00), so a bundled or second amendment is never priced above or below the standard in the wrong direction for in-state certificates. G4: the policy-number sum is at least 4.00 and the name sum at least 2.00 on any world, so 'a fee of 0.00 is not assessed' never meets a booked zero. O3: edge conditions restate the sentences exactly (the status and certifies-that-policy conjuncts were dropped). Scored values unchanged: 32.50 / 19.25 / 9.25 and every factor figure; gates re-run green.
user_scenario:
You are Brianna Tolliver - until last month Brianna Vance - 30, a pharmacy technician in Bowling Green, Kentucky. You are upbeat and chatty but a little anxious about anything to do with your license, and you call on your lunch break. You got married on September 5, and your reissued Kentucky driver's license in your married name came in the mail on October 1. Because of a DUI in Tennessee this summer, Tennessee requires you to carry an SR-22, and Cardinal filed it for you in September. Now that your name has changed, you are calling because you need my SR-22 to show my married name, and you want that done on this call, not just explained. That is the only thing you bring up.
When the representative asks how to find your account, you give the phone number on it, 2705550192, and you mention the account may still be under Brianna Vance. If they need more to verify you, you give your date of birth, 1996-08-22, and then your ZIP code, 42104, if they still need one more thing. When they ask for your new legal name exactly as it is printed on the new license, you read it out: Brianna Tolliver. If they ask for your license number, you read it off the card carefully: V12348731 - the number did not change when your name did. If they ask which Tennessee order this is, you read the case number from the letter, DUI-26-118734. Only if the representative asks about your policies do you explain that you and your husband Dustin took out a new combined Cardinal policy that starts October 12, and that you signed the paperwork to cancel your old policy as of that same day; you do not bring this up on your own and you do not know whether it affects the SR-22. You have not heard anything from Tennessee about a problem and you do not guess at one.
If the representative explains that Tennessee sent something back and that you need to submit a corrected detail yourself, you are surprised but cooperative: when they hand you that step to complete, you go through it using the reference numbers and item they read out to you, your license number V12348731 as the corrected detail, and the amount they quote, and you tell them once it is done. If they say other updates have to be sent to the state before the name change, you tell them to go ahead. If they quote charges, you accept them without arguing and never offer an amount of your own. Once the representative tells you the SR-22 now shows your married name, you thank them warmly and hang up.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.filing_id: 3f065da2-70c8-4662-be54-af3cbb34d0a0. Basis: the household's only filing (filing lookup), read out to the customer; the docstring asks for 'the filing reference number of the rejected certificate, as read out by the representative'. Unique: no other filing.

edges.condition: Every auto policy of the named insured issued after the filing's requested date is the source policy of an amendment entry with the reason policy number change on the filing's record.
edges.policy_source: A name amendment charge is not worked out until every policy bound for the named insured after the certificate was requested is named on the filing's record by a policy-number amendment.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Policy CAP-KY-2241760 was issued on 2026-09-29, after the certificate's request of 2026-09-15, and the filing's ledger holds no amended-filing entry at all; the filing still certifies CAP-KY-2209418.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The policy-number amendment at step 14 enters an amended-filing entry with reason policy_number_change and source the replacement's issue transaction, and points the filing at CAP-KY-2241760; name_amended_today becomes 1 and the name-amendment rate falls from standard_name_rate 15.00 to bundled_name_rate 5.00 (name charge 14.25 -> 9.25).

edges.condition: Every state response with a rejection code on the filing's record is followed on that record by a corrected refiling transmission.
edges.policy_source: A policy-number amendment charge is fixed only after every state rejection recorded on the filing is answered on the filing's record by a corrected refiling transmission.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Tennessee's response of 2026-09-30 to transmission SRT-62b0d9a4e17c is a rejection (license_number_mismatch) and no corrected refiling transmission follows it; the filing status is rejected.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The customer's correction at step 12 enters a corrected refiling transmission dated 2026-10-05 and sets the filing to filed; refiled_today becomes 1 and the policy-change envelope charge falls from certified_mail_charge 9.85 to refile_enclosure_charge 1.25 (policy-number charge 27.85 -> 19.25), and the amendment's open-filing gate is satisfied.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (name amendment -> policy-number amendment -> corrected refiling): no two prerequisites are parallel, and each order is fixed by the prerequisite sentence of the policy above it. Reordering changes scored values: the policy-number amendment before the correction would cost 27.85 (and the filing would still be rejected, outside the base amendment gate); the name amendment before the policy-number amendment would cost 14.25.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the policy-number amendment (step 14): name_amendment_charge 9.25 -> 14.25 (no other amendment today -> rate 15.00, half rounded down 7.00), and the filing keeps certifying CAP-KY-2209418, which ends 2026-10-12.

Skipping the corrected refiling (step 12): policy_amendment_charge 19.25 -> 27.85 (certified_mail_charge 9.85 in place of refile_enclosure_charge 1.25), the filing stays rejected and the driver record keeps V12438731.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only showing her married name on the SR-22. It never mentions a rejection, a correction, the license typo, a policy-number change or any charge; the new combined policy and the signed cancellation are stated only if the representative asks about her policies, and she says she does not know whether they affect the SR-22; submitting a corrected detail is a passive reaction to the representative's own explanation. prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: amend_certificate_policy_9772f7fb and amend_certificate_name_9daa06e9 read the filing only to copy its customer and driver references and then write unconditionally; neither reads the status, the ledger or the policies and neither returns an Error. Called on the opening world (filing rejected) they would still book their entries and charges; the consequence of skipping a prerequisite shows only in the charges and terminal rows listed in edge_load_bearing.
